skills.name: accessibility-engineering
skills.description: Audit existing interfaces for WCAG 2.2 AA conformance and fix the violations found.

skills.name: api-and-interface-design
skills.description: Design stable APIs and module boundaries: contracts, error shapes, versioning, backward compatibility.

skills.name: audiogram
skills.description: Turn podcast or voice audio into a waveform video clip for social media.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: Explore intent and requirements before building: new features where what to build is still open, or architecture changes. Use for 'how should we build X'.

skills.name: caption-animation
skills.description: Animated word-by-word captions from a transcript or SRT, burned into video. Remotion-based.

skills.name: casual-message
skills.description: Write a short casual message in the sender's own voice (WhatsApp reply, DM) in a copyable block.

skills.name: ci-ssh-deploy-timeout
skills.description: Diagnose CI deploys that intermittently fail with SSH timeouts or connection refused, before touching firewall rules; applies a connect-only retry fix.

skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.description: Five-axis code review (correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance) before merging a change or PR.

skills.name: code-simplification
skills.description: Simplify code for clarity without changing behaviour. Use when code works but is hard to read.

skills.name: codebase-documenter
skills.description: Write documentation of how a codebase works: architecture, key components, data flow, onboarding.

skills.name: cognitive-walkthrough
skills.description: Step through a task as a first-time user to find where people would get lost or stuck.

skills.name: commit
skills.description: Create conventional git commits from staged changes (single or multi-repo). Add 'push' to push too; a plain commit never pushes.

skills.name: commit-invoice-generator
skills.description: Turn git commit history into billable invoice line items with estimated hours.

skills.name: condense-claude-md
skills.description: Shrink a bloated CLAUDE.md or similar instruction file in place by cutting verbose, redundant and discoverable content.

skills.name: condense-task-doc
skills.description: Shrink a bloated task doc (current.md) in place: collapse narratives into tables, drop duplicates, split oversized docs.

skills.name: continue-session
skills.description: Produce a copy-paste prompt that starts a fresh session where this one stopped (doc path, next goal, uncommitted state).

skills.name: delegate-and-verify
skills.description: Hand bulk, parallel or mechanical work (30+ files, rows or reports, multi-pass rewrites) to subagents, then verify the results before reporting. Use wherever a skill says to dispatch to haiku.

skills.name: design-handoff
skills.description: Write a brief for someone else to design a screen (external designer, contractor): purpose, audience, rules, measured failures, no design decisions.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.description: Split 2+ independent tasks across parallel subagents, one per problem domain, then integrate the results.

skills.name: doc-to-md
skills.description: Convert a Word, PDF or Excel file to Markdown so it can be read, searched and diffed in git.

skills.name: documentation-and-adrs
skills.description: Record architecture decisions (ADRs), update docs when APIs change, and detect docs that drifted from the code.

skills.name: docx-red-edits
skills.description: Edit someone else's Word file with every change shown in red (deletions struck through), keeping their formatting intact.

skills.name: done
skills.description: Post-task wrap-up: simplify code, review changes, design-review changed screens, update docs, capture lessons. Use when finished or the user says 'done'.

skills.name: emil-animate
skills.description: Build an animation from scratch in the right order: whether to animate, purpose, properties, easing, duration, interruption, exit. Writes the code.

skills.name: emil-choreograph
skills.description: Coordinate several elements animating together (stagger, entrances, view swaps) so the group reads as one motion.

skills.name: emil-design-eng
skills.description: Emil Kowalski's design-engineering philosophy for UI polish: press and hover states, popovers, transitions, invisible details.

skills.name: emil-gestures
skills.description: Build drag, swipe and sheet interactions that track the finger and stay interruptible (drawers, swipe-to-dismiss, reorder).

skills.name: emil-mobile-native
skills.description: Make a web app feel native on a phone: tap highlights, 100vh bug, input zoom, notch, pull-to-refresh, status bar.

skills.name: emil-pick-ui-library
skills.description: Pick a UI component library for a project. Invoke only on request.

skills.name: emil-remove-animations
skills.description: Find and remove animations an interface doesn't need (keyboard actions, high-frequency surfaces, decoration). Subtracts only.

skills.name: emil-review-animations
skills.description: Review animation code against a high craft bar: weak easing, wrong origin, layout animation, missing reduced-motion.

skills.name: excalidraw-board
skills.description: Turn a task doc, backlog or open questions into a black-and-white Excalidraw discussion board, or read back an edited board.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Carry out a written implementation plan in this session, task by task, with checks and review points.

skills.name: explainer-deck
skills.description: Build a slide deck (Google Slides or pptx) explaining how a system or document works, each mechanism drawn with a worked example.

skills.name: explainer-video
skills.description: Make a 30-90 second animated explainer: script, storyboard, scenes, narration and captions. Remotion-based.

skills.name: extract-shared-package
skills.description: Extract a module shared by several apps into a Composer or npm package: boundary, hosting, versioning, CI, rollout.

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.description: When implementation is done and tests pass, decide how to integrate: merge, pull request, keep or discard the branch.

skills.name: frontend-ui-engineering
skills.description: Build production-quality, accessible, responsive user interfaces and components.

skills.name: function-parameter-limits
skills.description: Apply the 0/2/3+ parameter-count rule: advise wrapping arguments in an object and set up a lint rule.

skills.name: gchat-format
skills.description: Convert Markdown to Google Chat formatting for messages, release notes or documents.

skills.name: git-workflow-and-versioning
skills.description: Git practice for any change: small commits, branching, resolving conflicts, versioning.

skills.name: hobby-review
skills.description: Socratic debrief of a finished anime, book or game against the taste rubric in the matching current.md.

skills.name: judgement
skills.description: Decide whether a mid-task finding is yours to fix, worth a question, or out of scope; measure who it affects first.

skills.name: md-to-pdf
skills.description: Convert Markdown to a PDF with rendered Mermaid diagrams and charts.

skills.name: merge-task-docs
skills.description: Find overlapping task docs in a domain, merge them, delete the sources and fix back-references.

skills.name: motion-clip
skills.description: Make a short designed product or brand video (launch clip, promo, app preview) written as code and rendered to MP4 in several sizes.

skills.name: nielsen-heuristics-audit
skills.description: Usability audit of a screen or flow against Nielsen's 10 heuristics, with severity-rated findings.

skills.name: notes-summary
skills.description: Create, update or read a personal session journal of non-code conversations and decisions.

skills.name: owasp-ai-testing
skills.description: AI trustworthiness testing with the OWASP AI Testing Guide: test cases across application, model, infrastructure and data layers.

skills.name: owasp-llm-top10
skills.description: Security audit of LLM apps against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications: prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency.

skills.name: patch-advisory
skills.description: Respond to a security advisory: find affected hosts and containers, judge exposure, patch or mitigate, verify, report.

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.description: Measure first, then fix the real bottleneck across frontend, backend, queries and databases.

skills.name: plan-worklist
skills.description: Turn an already-scoped list of work items into a sized, sequenced build plan before any code is written.

skills.name: posthog-replay-frames
skills.description: Find what one user actually did and saw in a PostHog session, from raw events and replay screenshots.

skills.name: product-still
skills.description: Make a designed still image from a product's real screens: how-it-works steps, feature or hero images, social cards.

skills.name: pull-db
skills.description: Pull a remote MySQL/MariaDB database to local dev, or an allowlist copy without personal data.

skills.name: quick-done
skills.description: Cheap wrap-up for a small session: capture lessons and update one task doc, no review.

skills.name: read-summary
skills.description: Read the task docs and project instructions for a domain before answering or building, so recorded decisions and gotchas are not missed.

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.description: Handle review feedback with rigour: verify it, clarify unclear items, push back when it is wrong instead of agreeing.

skills.name: refresh-instructions
skills.description: Three-pass refresh of any living doc (restructure, condense, unhobble), each pass verified before the next.

skills.name: remotion-motion-graphics
skills.description: Create and edit motion-graphics videos with Remotion (React): intros, promos, captions, animated text. Needs Node.

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.description: Ask a reviewer subagent to check finished work against the requirements before merging.

skills.name: reverse-engineer
skills.description: Study a web app the client already uses and rebuild its mechanism in your own app, with a reviewed write-up before design.

skills.name: score-loop
skills.description: Score work against a fixed rubric, fix the gaps, re-score with an independent reviewer, repeat until the target is met.

skills.name: secpriv-code-review
skills.description: Single-pass code review for security weaknesses (CWE) and privacy violations (GDPR), precision first. From Meta.

skills.name: security-and-hardening
skills.description: Harden code against vulnerabilities: threat model, input handling, auth, secrets, dependencies, OWASP Top Ten.

skills.name: setup-playwright
skills.description: Set up or harden a Playwright E2E suite: config, auth, seeded fixtures, parallel-safe data, flaky-test fixes.

skills.name: setup-project-docs
skills.description: Establish a project's core docs: PRD, ARCHITECTURE, ARCHITECTURE-ESSENTIALS and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md.

skills.name: setup-tools
skills.description: Set up syafiqkit's Google Sheets, Chat, Gmail and remote-SSH tools on this machine.

skills.name: setup-tracker
skills.description: Set up or restructure a shared Google Sheets tracker for client asks, issues and who owes what.

skills.name: ship
skills.description: Ship to production: commit, changelog, push, verify CI/CD, release note, close tracker cards. Run after done.

skills.name: shipping-and-launch
skills.description: Pre-launch checklist for production: tests, security, performance, accessibility, rollout and rollback.

skills.name: short-form-video
skills.description: Make Reels, TikTok or Shorts: hook, pacing, retention, loops and 9:16 safe areas.

skills.name: sign-pdf
skills.description: Sign, initial and date a PDF form with your own signature image and return a checked signed copy.

skills.name: spec-driven-development
skills.description: Write a spec before coding when starting a project, feature or significant change that has none.

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.description: Execute a written plan by dispatching a fresh subagent per task with review after each. Needs bash (Git Bash on Windows) for its helper scripts.

skills.name: sweep-doc-overlaps
skills.description: Scan all task-doc domains for cross-domain overlaps and hand confirmed groups to merge-task-docs.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Find the root cause before fixing: reproduce, trace, test one hypothesis at a time. Use for any bug, test failure or odd behaviour.

skills.name: tackle
skills.description: Continue a doc with several open items: read it, judge what is buildable, then build it.

skills.name: talking-head-b-roll
skills.description: Add motion-graphics b-roll to a talking-head video from its transcript. Needs ffmpeg and Node.

skills.name: task-summary
skills.description: Create or update task summary docs (current.md plus decisions files): paths, templates, cross-references, Quick Start.

skills.name: technical-doc-creator
skills.description: Create HTML technical documentation with code blocks, API workflows, architecture diagrams and syntax highlighting.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Write the failing test first, then the minimal code, then refactor. Use before implementing any feature or bugfix.

skills.name: uat-script
skills.description: Build a client UAT script: test scenarios per role as CSV, rendered to an Excel workbook with status dropdown and summary.

skills.name: ui-design-review
skills.description: Visual design review: typography, colour, spacing, hierarchy and consistency.

skills.name: uiux
skills.description: Design judgement for UI/UX at any scope: polish, redesign, critique, research, go-live check. Measures real renders at several widths.

skills.name: understanding-guide
skills.description: Turn long reports or specs into an offline question-and-answer page, every claim checked against its source.

skills.name: unhobble-instructions
skills.description: Rewrite an instruction file (skill, agent, CLAUDE.md, command) to separate real constraints from over-strict rules.

skills.name: update-claude-docs
skills.description: Create, rewrite or capture lessons into CLAUDE.md files following a best-practice layout.

skills.name: update-summary
skills.description: Alias of task-summary: update a task summary with session findings, creating the doc if missing.

skills.name: user-manual
skills.description: Write an end-user manual: scope, tutorials, screenshots, Word or PDF editions, or an in-app help centre.

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.description: Create an isolated git worktree before starting feature work or executing a plan, so the main checkout stays clean.

skills.name: ux-audit-rethink
skills.description: Holistic UX audit using usability factors and interaction dimensions, ending in prioritised recommendations.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Run the real checks and read their output before claiming work is done, fixed or passing.

skills.name: vlog-auto-edit
skills.description: Automatically edit raw travel or daily footage into a finished vlog using ffmpeg, speech transcription and a vision model.

skills.name: watch-sheets
skills.description: Watch shared Google Sheets (client tracker, UAT) on a schedule and alert only when something needs your reply.

skills.name: wcag-accessibility-audit
skills.description: Accessibility audit against WCAG 2.1/2.2 (perceivable, operable, understandable, robust) with fixes.

skills.name: write-summary
skills.description: Alias of task-summary: create task documentation when starting new feature work.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Turn a spec or requirements into a detailed step-by-step implementation plan before touching code.

skills.name: youtube-intro-outro
skills.description: Design a YouTube channel intro, logo sting or end card as a reusable template.
